title: Toastmasters International Impromptu Speaking & Fluency Architecture
evaluation: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5) — Benchmark for Public Speaking & Impromptu Fluency

table_topics_frameworks.best_for: Opinion questions, policy evaluations, direct IELTS Speaking Part 3 prompts

steps.description: State your core stance clearly and decisively in 1 sentence.
Explain *why* you hold this stance using logical justification.
Illustrate with a vivid personal anecdote, historical precedent, or statistic.
Restate your main point with elevated vocabulary to seal the argument.

table_topics_frameworks.best_for: Value judgements and moral / philosophical questions

steps.description: Provide the ethical or pragmatic basis.
Demonstrate the real-world consequences if this value is ignored.

table_topics_frameworks.best_for: Questions about technology, social trends, work habits, urban living

steps.description: A generation ago, how did society handle this issue?
What is the status quo today? What friction exists?
What will likely unfold over the next 20 years?

meeting_evaluations_and_defense_against_.ah_counter_role: Identifies and tallies crutch words: 'um', 'ah', 'er', 'you know', 'like', 'actually', 'sort of'.
meeting_evaluations_and_defense_against_.grammarian_protocol: Tracks fossilized errors, subject-verb agreement slips, and introduces a 'Word of the Day' to expand active lexical range.

curated_table_topics_ielts_bank.prompt: If artificial intelligence can outperform human doctors, should algorithms have the legal authority to diagnose patients without human oversight?
Despite living in densely populated modern cities, why are more individuals experiencing chronic isolation than previous generations?
Does the traditional 4-year university degree still provide adequate return on investment in today's rapidly evolving global economy?
Should individual consumer choices or governmental industrial mandates bear the primary responsibility for reversing climate change?
In an increasingly homogenised global culture, is it essential for nation-states to spend tax revenue preserving obsolete dialects and traditions?
